create_mujoco_spec_model: create a MuJoCo model programmatically using MjSpec with bodies, geoms, joints, and sites
compile_spec_to_mujoco_model: compile an MjSpec into a compiled MuJoCo model and MjData for simulation
load_mujoco_model_from_xml: load a MuJoCo model from an XML string or file using MjSpec.from_string or MjSpec.from_file
attach_child_spec_to_parent: attach a child MjSpec to a parent spec at a site or frame with prefix and suffix name transformations
test_mujoco_spec_bindings: test MuJoCo MjSpec bindings including body lists, geom lists, sensors, actuators, and plugin assignment
